title: 82627B0010-BEPA: GI-CONS-7: Installation of Green Infrastructure at Various NYC Parks in Queens and The Bronx
agency_path: City of New York > Environmental Protection
description_text:
The Department continues to implement an extensive system of GI practices at various NYC Parks in Queens and The Bronx to be built over the next several years to capture and manage stormwater runoff from impervious surfaces. These practices include but are not limited to bioretention systems, permeable pavement, synthetic turf, wetlands, green roofs, subsurface detention/retention systems, and/or any combination thereof. This Competitive Sealed Bid (RFx') is being released through PASSPort, New York Citys online procurement portal. Responses to this RFx should be submitted via PASSPort. To access the solicitation, vendors should visit the PASSPort Public Portal Navigator at https://passport.cityofnewyork.us/page.aspx/en/rfp/request_browse_public. This will take you to the Public Portal of all procurements in the PASSPort system. To quickly locate the RFx, insert the EPIN 82627B0010 into the Keywords search field. If you need assistance submitting a response, please contact MOCS Service Desk: mocssupport.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/8
